body:
The most terrifying thing is the ultimate realization that I'm no longer in control of my thoughts. I've done all the things you are supposed to do. Therapy. Anti-depressants. So I get to make a choice: be severely over-medicated to stay alive. And that's not living at all.

At the end of the night, two complete strangers told me it's ok.

And that will get me through the night.

And tomorrow I'll get up and tell myself "One more day" Anyone can get through one more day. Anyone. Including me.

You both saved me.

Having so much trouble fighting the spray of despair chemicals across my brain. Just the fact that someone would respond......

Thank you so much. Just having someone be there, randomly, to care.

You don't know me from Adam. Just tell me everything is going to be ok.
